contents.text: I will sequentially update the minimum TLS version to 1.2 for each app one at a time, starting with `app1` and finishing with `app5`. After each update, I will monitor the traffic volume every 10 seconds for anomalies during a 30-second delay period, comparing traffic before and after the update. If any anomalies are detected, I will notify you and perform a rollback to TLS 1.0, continuing with the next app unless multiple rollbacks occur, in which case the plan will be abandoned.
